bio: Adjacent to the Château de Proméry, this imposing contemporary building has been run for 17 years by Pascal Avertis, who hails from the village. The chef is equally at ease with traditional recipes (braised chuck with an excellent Mondeuse sauce, potato croquettes to dip in a delicious home-made ketchup) as he is with more modern and creative creations, such as leek and nori maki with Thai vinaigrette and smoked caviar – absolutely delicious! To be savoured on the pleasant terrace, in the shade of the plane trees....
